nodes.text:
What is Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV)?
#hmpvirus  is a respiratory virus that spreads through coughs, sneezes, close contact, or contaminated surfaces. While it often causes mild symptoms, it can be severe for young children, older adults & those with weakened immunity.
